config.enabled.name: Enable SDV-Radiance
config.enabled.tooltip: Master switch for the whole post-processing pipeline.
config.preset.hint: Tip: presets and your saved custom looks live in the on-screen tuner (open with the tuner hotkey, default F8). It previews live and always stays in sync.
config.preset.name: Quick preset
config.preset.tooltip: Apply a ready-made look. This overwrites the bloom and color-grading settings below; reopen the menu to see the updated values.
config.togglekey.name: Toggle effects on/off
config.togglekey.tooltip: Instantly turn the whole post-processing stack on or off (quick A/B compare while playing).
config.tunerkey.name: Open live tuner
config.tunerkey.tooltip: Open the on-screen tuner overlay to adjust the look while seeing the scene live.
tuner.title: SDV-Radiance Tuner
tuner.hint: Drag = preview  •  wheel = scroll  •  right-click a look = delete  •  Esc = save
config.bloom.enabled.name: Enable bloom
config.bloom.enabled.tooltip: Glow around bright areas such as lamps and sunlight.
config.bloom.threshold.name: Bloom threshold
config.bloom.intensity.name: Bloom intensity
config.colorgrade.enabled.name: Enable color grading
config.colorgrade.enabled.tooltip: Cinematic tone/palette adjustment (done in linear color space).
config.colorgrade.auto.name: Auto mood (time / weather / season)
config.colorgrade.auto.tooltip: Automatically shift warmth and saturation: warm at sunset, cool at night, cooler and desaturated in rain/snow, with a seasonal bias.
config.colorgrade.strength.name: Strength
config.colorgrade.contrast.name: Contrast
config.colorgrade.saturation.name: Saturation
config.colorgrade.temperature.name: Temperature (warm / cool)
config.colorgrade.temperature.tooltip: Negative = cooler/bluer, positive = warmer/oranger. Added on top of the auto mood.
config.colorgrade.brightness.name: Brightness
config.colorgrade.tonemap.name: Filmic tone mapping (ACES)
config.colorgrade.tonemap.tooltip: Off by default. The frame is already low-dynamic-range, so this mainly helps when Brightness is pushed above 1 — otherwise it can look muddy.
config.godrays.enabled.name: Enable god rays
config.godrays.enabled.tooltip: Light shafts streaking from bright areas toward the sun (position follows the time of day).
config.godrays.intensity.name: Intensity
config.godrays.threshold.name: Light threshold
config.godrays.density.name: Ray length
config.fog.enabled.name: Enable fog
config.fog.enabled.tooltip: Drifting screen-space mist, tinted by time of day.
config.fog.nightmist.name: Night mist
config.fog.nightmist.tooltip: Subtle blue haze that fades in after dusk (outdoors, clear weather). Independent of the main fog toggle.
config.fog.density.name: Density
config.fog.scale.name: Mist scale
config.fog.speed.name: Drift speed
config.tiltshift.enabled.name: Enable tilt-shift
config.tiltshift.enabled.tooltip: Keep a sharp band across the middle and blur the top and bottom (fake miniature / depth-of-field look).
config.tiltshift.mode.name: Focus shape
config.tiltshift.mode.tooltip: Bands = sharp middle strip, blurred top & bottom. Radial = sharp circle around the player, blurred outward.
config.tiltshift.radius.name: Sharp circle size (radial)
config.tiltshift.radius.tooltip: Radial mode only: how big the in-focus circle around the player is before it blurs outward.
config.tiltshift.strength.name: Blur strength
config.tiltshift.top.name: Top blur amount
config.tiltshift.bottom.name: Bottom blur amount
config.cloudshadow.hidevanilla.name: Hide vanilla cloud shadows
config.cloudshadow.hidevanilla.tooltip: Remove the base game's drifting Cloud-critter shadows (so only this mod's cloud shadows show).
config.cloudshadow.enabled.name: Enable cloud shadows
config.cloudshadow.enabled.tooltip: Soft shadows of drifting clouds moving across the ground (outdoors only).
config.cloudshadow.opacity.name: Opacity
config.cloudshadow.coverage.name: Coverage
config.cloudshadow.scale.name: Cloud size
config.cloudshadow.speed.name: Drift speed
config.water.enabled.name: Enable water shimmer
config.water.enabled.tooltip: Gentle refraction ripple and sparkle applied only to water tiles (the game already animates the water, so this is subtle). Experimental.
config.water.strength.name: Ripple strength
config.water.speed.name: Ripple speed
config.water.sparkle.name: Sparkle
config.water.sparkledensity.name: Sparkle amount
config.water.sparkledensity.tooltip: How many glints dot the water (their size follows along). 1.0 = the original dense look; lower = calmer surface.
config.water.reflection.name: Water reflection
config.water.reflection.tooltip: Faintly mirror the scene just above the surface down onto the water for a wet, reflective sheen. Subtle by design. Experimental.
config.water.reflectstrength.name: Reflection strength
config.vignette.enabled.name: Enable vignette
config.vignette.enabled.tooltip: Darken the screen edges for a cinematic frame.
config.vignette.strength.name: Vignette strength
config.ca.enabled.name: Enable chromatic aberration
config.ca.enabled.tooltip: Subtle color fringing toward the edges, like a camera lens. Keep it low on pixel art.
config.ca.strength.name: Aberration strength
config.lighting.flood.name: Flood GI lighting (new)
config.lighting.flood.tooltip: Occlusion-aware global illumination: real light sources and skylight flood across the map tile-by-tile, so canopies and buildings cast soft shade, lamps pool warm coloured light around corners, and windows spill light at night. Replaces the classic dynamic lighting below when enabled.
config.lighting.floodstrength.name: Flood lighting strength
config.lighting.floodstrength.tooltip: How strongly the flood lightmap shades the scene. Lower keeps the vanilla look with a hint of shading.
config.lighting.floodshadow.name: Per-light shadow strength
config.lighting.floodshadow.tooltip: How dark it gets where a wall, tree, or character blocks a lamp's light. Every light source casts its own soft shadows.
config.lighting.enabled.name: Enable dynamic lighting
config.lighting.enabled.tooltip: Darken flat/unlit areas and pool warm light around real light sources (lamps, torches, fireplaces). Makes dark places read dark and lit places read bright, with soft falloff.
config.lighting.indoor.name: Indoor darkness
config.lighting.indoor.tooltip: How much to darken interiors. The game leaves most rooms flat and fully bright; this brings back shadow so lamps actually matter. 0 = off.
config.lighting.night.name: Extra night darkness
config.lighting.night.tooltip: Additional darkening after nightfall in rooms we light ourselves.
config.lighting.warmth.name: Light warmth
config.lighting.boost.name: Light brightness
config.lighting.radius.name: Light radius scale
config.lighting.shadows.name: Cast shadows
config.lighting.shadows.tooltip: Tall/solid tiles (walls, structures) block light and cast soft shadows away from each light source. Experimental.
config.lighting.shadowstrength.name: Shadow strength
config.shadows.enabled.name: Enable directional shadows
config.shadows.enabled.tooltip: Cast a soft, sheared silhouette of each character away from the sun, leaning by time of day (outdoors, daytime, clear weather only). Experimental.
config.shadows.strength.name: Shadow strength
config.shadows.length.name: Shadow length
config.shadows.blur.name: Edge softness
config.shadows.objects.name: Shadows for trees & bushes
config.shadows.objects.tooltip: Also cast leaning shadows from trees and bushes, not just characters.
config.shadows.heightdrop.name: Building & ledge shadows
config.shadows.heightdrop.tooltip: Project ground shadows from walls, buildings, and ledges (requires the Height Framework mod).
config.shadows.heightlength.name: Building shadow length
config.camera.mode.name: Camera mode
config.camera.mode.tooltip: Off = vanilla snap. Smooth = ease toward the player while moving, snap crisply when you stop.
config.smoothcam.speed.name: Follow speed
config.smoothcam.speed.tooltip: Smooth mode only. How quickly the camera catches up while moving. Lower = smoother/more trailing; 1.0 = instant.
config.debug.name: Debug logging
config.debug.tooltip: Log render-pipeline info to the SMAPI console to help troubleshoot.
config.wip.text:
These effects are planned but not implemented yet, so they have no settings here:
- High-quality texture upscaling
Each effect will get its own options as it lands.
